t: This Essentials Caution Wet Floor A-frame sign provides essential safety warnings for potential slip hazards in various environments. Constructed from durable 2mm polypropylene, this robust 600mm x 290mm sign is designed for reliable performance. Ideal for busy commercial environments, public buildings, and industrial workplaces, it clearly alerts pedestrians to wet floors following cleaning, spills, or leaks. The bright yellow colour ensures high visibility, helping to prevent accidents and maintain site safety. Its lightweight design allows for easy placement and repositioning, and the foldable A-frame structure enables convenient storage when not in use.
b: Bright Yellow Colour for Clear Warning
